about: The refusals of submission composition (SUB, DEFINE, OUTPUT-1, OUTPUT-2), of admitting held rows as a composed dataset's published rows (XPT-7, XPT-8, JSON-3, JSON-4, CT-11), of the findings the Define-XML and XPT encoders make (DEFINE-3, DEFINE-16, DEFINE-24, DEFINE-25, JSON-2, XPT-10), and of preparing a specification that restates a mandatory column (CHECK-5, SUB-11). A study is the `study` document, a 1.0 project whose `sdtm` section lists one specification of the SDTM model (D4, D16, D25), or `value_level`, the same with a second column its value-level entries select on, or `cited_terminology`, the same with two columns bound to the codelists FIRST and SECOND of three codelist sources, the first and third citing one release of the CDISC/NCI SDTM terminology and the second a later one, after the case's edits. The cases whose table compared only part of each issue compare those fields, or those keys of its context; the cases whose table found its issues by cause among several, or left a defect of their input without a row, say `among`.
